judgement.reason: Label Studio supports PostgreSQL and S3-backed storage, so moving uploads off local disk is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./mydata:/label-studio/data:rw (docker-compose.yml nginx), volume ./mydata:/label-studio/data:rw (docker-compose.yml app)
reviews.reason: Even with PostgreSQL selected, the data directory also holds uploaded files, and no shown setting moves uploads to S3, so the shown lines do not prove that durable local storage is unneeded.
